description: The prumo's guard. Blocks merge unless the installation delegated it (`forge.delegated_merge: true`), and always while a review or a delivery runs; and any push, commit or rewrite on a protected branch (`forge.protected_branches`) of a repository the prumo works on ALWAYS; blocks push, commit and moving the item while a review runs (`.claude/.task-review-ativo`, which `review.py` creates and removes); and, while a delivery runs (`.claude/.prumo-deliver-ativo`, which `deliver.py` creates and removes), blocks push, moving the item, `git add -A`, rewriting the base, and any write inside its worktree before a gated plan was approved. A file outside the roots the profile declares, or that the measurement did not name, is not refused: `deliver.py conclude` declares it in the report. The matcher covers Bash, the file-writing tools, and the MCP tools that move or transition an item: the tracker is configurable, so the guard matches the ACTION in the tool name rather than one provider's spelling. A guarantee by hook, not by instruction: the model can err, and text injected into an item or a proposal can try.
